Intro Text: SIT helps schools improve by unlocking the knowledge and experience of all staff. SIT helps governor/trustees to guide leadership by providing easy to read information about the school. SIT supports governors/trustees dive deeper into issues and helps them to use their experience to help schools improve. SIT helps to create dialogue between governors/trustees and SLT around key areas of school improvement.

SIT helps schools improve by unlocking the knowledge and experience of all staff. SIT supports headteachers to improve their school and it's leadership by engaging everyone in tracking school progress. SIT helps headteachers to get improve their school by accessing and ordering the improvement data from across the school. SIT helps headteachers to save money on external consultancy by unlocking the expertise already in the school.

SIT helps the SLT to update, review and progress the school improvement journey regularly through the simple interface and easy to complete audits.
